name: barbell reverse grip incline bench row
description: A barbell row with an underhand grip, done chest down on an incline bench. The support removes momentum and targets the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, feet on the floor.
Grip the barbell below you underhand, palms facing forward, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
